parameters.query:
select day_req.*, rt.template_id ,rt.goal, rt.level, rt.week_schedule
from routine_templates rt
join template_days using(week_schedule)
join day_requirements as day_req using (template_day_id)  
where days_per_week = {{ $items('ProcessUserPreferences')[0].json.days_available }}
and goal = '{{ $items('ProcessUserPreferences')[0].json.primary_goal }}'
and level = '{{ $items('ProcessUserPreferences')[0].json.fitness_level }}'
and (rt.environment = '{{ $items('ProcessUserPreferences')[0].json.processed.environment }}' 
     OR (rt.environment IS NULL AND '{{ $items('ProcessUserPreferences')[0].json.processed.environment }}' = 'GYM'));

SELECT w.day_name, w.exercise_order, w.sets, w.reps, w.rir, w."rest-seconds" as rest_seconds, w.tempo, e.spanish_name, e.main_muscle, e.secondary_muscles, e.equipment, e.link, e.role FROM workouts w JOIN exercises e USING(exercise_id) JOIN users_plans up ON up.user_id = w.user_id AND up.status = 'active' JOIN template_days td ON td.week_schedule = up.week_schedule AND td.title = w.day_name WHERE w.user_id = '{{ $items('GetUser')[0].json.user_id }}' AND w.week = 1 ORDER BY td.day_number, w.exercise_order
